prompt: Tell me all of the candidates for Dublin South-West in the most recent Irish General Election, as of Jan 2024, who received 5% or less of the total "First Preference" vote, excluding candidates who ran as Independents with no political party.
instruction: Tell me all of the candidates for Dublin South-West in the most recent Irish General Election, as of Jan 2024, who received 5% or less of the total "First Preference" vote, excluding candidates who ran as Independents with no political party.
answer:
Based on the 2024 Irish General Election (held 29 November 2024) results for Dublin South-West, the candidates who received **5% or less of first preference votes** and **were not Independents with no party affiliation** are:

| Candidate | Party | First Preference Votes | Vote Share |
|-----------|-------|------------------------|------------|
| **Saoirse Ní Chónaráin** | Aontú | 2,599 | 3.9% |
| **Francis Noel Duffy** | Green Party | 1,931 | 2.9% |
| **Yan Mac Oireachtaigh** | National Party | 1,450 | 2.2% |

**Total valid poll:** 66,823 (5% threshold = 3,341 votes)

**Excluded** (Independents with no party):
- Patrick Pearse Holohan (2,457 votes, 3.7%)
- Niall Hade (129 votes, 0.2%)
- Colm O'Keeffe (117 votes, 0.2%)

Source: [Independent.ie election results](https://elections.independent.ie/election-2024/dublin-south-west) and [Irish Politics](https://www.irishpolitics.ie/constituencies/dublin-south-west) for Dublin South-West 2024 general election constituency returns.
